allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: DELPHI WORLD MONEY LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding 'Board Approve the allotment of Bonus Shares'.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: DELPHI WORLD MONEY LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 5223295 securities pursuant to Rights Issue at its meeting held on November 10, 2025

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: DELPHI WORLD MONEY LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 27, 2025, titled "Media Release:  Delphi World Money Ltd. Rights Issue Opens Today to Power Next-Phase Growth and Global Travel Fintech Integration ".

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: DELPHI WORLD MONEY LIMITED has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on October 08, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 5223295  : 11127890 , i.e 5223295  Equity Shares for every 11127890  Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 191 per share.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: DELPHI WORLD MONEY LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Allotment of Equity Shares to Delphi World Money Limited consequent upon Conversion of Compulsorily Convertible Debentures
